text.plain: This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of Fire. While wearing it, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Elementals and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You know Ignan and have Immunity to Fire damage. Its Elemental Compulsion has save DC 18. The ring has 5 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn, and casts its printed fire spells at save DC 18.
